title: ability.used
description: server → host and clients. Announces that a role ability is now spent for this mission. An outcome-log message: the host applies its effect (for trigger OVER_BUDGET_WIN the host adds the +10 % budget).

outcomeSeq.description: Position in the room outcome log.

playerId.description: Current holder of the role; null if nobody holds it.

roundId.description: Vote round concerned (FLIGHT Decision Time, PM over-budget win); null otherwise.

OutcomeSeq.description: Position of a server-resolved outcome in the room outcome log; starts at 1 and increases by 1 per outcome for the lifetime of the room.

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).

RoleId.description: Mission Control role (§3.3), in canonical order.

RoundId.description: Vote round identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room for its whole lifetime.
